findings.claim: With --id, uniqueness is checked only against the working-tree store (validate_add). The git-aware burned-ID check (#479, git_claimed_ids in next_id_git_aware) is skipped, so an ID already claimed on an open branch or by a reverted commit is accepted and collides on merge. No test covers this.

The doc comment says every rivet ID is PREFIX-NNN, but rivet's own store at this commit has 52 IDs this rejects (ARCH-CORE-STORE, CTRL-CI, PROC-REPORTS, H-1.1, COMP_REQ__FLUSH__A). --id refuses IDs for these existing ID schemes, e.g. a new control or sub-hazard.
